release_scope: Source code only. Raw acquisitions and generated JSON/HTML reports are intentionally excluded.
note: The historical refactor_manifest.json pinned digest 6d9c702d... for an earlier engine revision labeled 0.27. The digest above identifies the frozen schema 0.37 engine shipped in this source release.

paper_environment.status: The exact Python patch version and CCL commit revisions used for the original paper-associated outputs were not recorded in the available release materials. Byte-identical reproduction of those archived reports is therefore not claimed.

posthoc_revalidation_environment.purpose: Post-hoc rerun of the available acquisitions; this is not a reconstruction of the unrecorded original parser environment.

known_output_variance.ephemeral_extraction_path: For ZIP inputs, the engine embeds a randomized temporary extraction directory in path-bearing fields. Canonicalize it before comparing entry-point outputs; see tests/test_output_equivalence.py.
known_output_variance.os_path_forms: Reports produced on Windows and POSIX hosts can differ in path separators and temporary roots.
known_output_variance.parser_revision: The 2026-08-09 post-hoc rerun decoded records that an earlier unpinned parser environment had reported as bad or undecoded. Parsed-record, live-record, relevant-record, and summary values can therefore differ across parser revisions.
known_output_variance.comparison_limit: The included equivalence test compares the legacy and packaged entry points within the same environment; it does not compare generated reports against archived paper outputs.

naming_note: The repository, package, and CLI use the paper's tool name CometTrace. The frozen engine emits an internal JSON tool label of comet-browser-reconstructor; this pre-freeze constant is left unchanged to preserve the pinned engine digest and does not affect analysis.
